name: Shoe Carnival, Inc.
business_overview: Shoe Carnival, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a family footwear retailer in the United States. It offers various products, including dress and casual shoes, sandals, boots, and athletic shoes; and non-athletics for men's, women's and children's shoes, as well as accessories. The company also operates stores. It sells its products through www.shoecarnival.com and www.shoestation.com, as well as through related mobile app. Shoe Carnival, Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Fort Mill, South Carolina.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Family footwear retailer operating stores and e-commerce in the United States.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Sales are slipping modestly year over year, but results edged past subdued expectations, reflecting a tough consumer backdrop. The core Shoe Carnival banner is showing signs of recovery, with comparable-store declines narrowing sharply from prior, steeper drops, while the Shoe Station banner continues to lag, creating a mixed demand picture. Margins remain under pressure. Despite operational sluggishness, the stock is seen as undervalued by some independent metrics, and insider buying has added a layer of cautious optimism to the narrative.

**Management strategy and execution:** Operating under an interim CEO, management offered full‑year guidance broadly in line with Street estimates, signaling a steady-as-she-goes approach. The team’s ability to modestly outperform consensus sales and comp forecasts in the latest quarter lends early credibility. Insider purchases during the period reinforce confidence in the direction. There is no evidence of aggressive strategic pivots; the focus appears to be on stabilizing the core banner and managing near‑term headwinds while the Shoe Station integration remains a work in progress.

# Shoe Carnival (NASDAQ:SCVL) Releases FY 2026 Earnings Guidance

Posted by Anthony Miller on May 29th, 2026

Share on Twitter Share on Facebook Share on LinkedIn Share on Stocktwits

Shoe Carnival (NASDAQ:SCVL– Get Free Report) issued an update on its FY 2026 earnings guidance on Friday morning. The company provided earnings per share (EPS) guidance of 1.400-1.600 for the period, compared to the consensus estimate of 1.480. The company issued revenue guidance of $1.1 billion-$1.1 billion, compared to the consensus revenue estimate of $1.1 billion.

## Shoe Carnival Stock Up 2.1%

Shares of SCVL stock opened at $17.60 on Friday. Shoe Carnival has a 12 month low of $14.91 and a 12 month high of $26.57. The firm has a market cap of $483.65 million, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.04 and a beta of 1.44. The stock has a 50-day moving average price of $17.24 and a 200 day moving average price of $18.12.
